00f12a19-bb96-4980-a4f5-11a1b9d604dd.why: The moonlit pines and clear spring over stones are Wang Wei's best-known image of mountain stillness.
The opening names a fresh autumn evening after rain in the empty hills.

0167687e-8325-48bf-8da4-3749c9ce0a74.why: The bright moon rising over the Tianshan and the long wind through Yumen Pass is Li Bai's grand frontier opening.
A stark couplet on battlefields from which no one has ever come home.

0174cbbc-31fa-4daf-b1cf-7f91c6a646a9.why: Grass that wildfire cannot kill and spring wind revives is one of the most recited lines in Chinese.
Fragrant green grass spreading over the old road shows the spring scene of the parting.

0445f296-5816-4ab9-a617-7d8ed29088ea.why: The grape wine, luminous cups and 'how many come back from war' make this the classic frontier quatrain.

07238ad9-c348-43d4-b1d7-25d89369286d.why: Meeting a messenger with no paper, the poet can only send word that he is safe, a famously plain and moving ending.

090b7792-2942-4f3c-a34d-caccd066c76f.why: 'A heart of ice in a jade pot' is the proverbial image of unstained integrity.

0a0f9231-d88c-4f81-b941-83b67a736194.why: The secret vow on the seventh night of the seventh month to be wings of one bird and branches of one tree is the poem's best-known pledge.
'Heaven and earth will end, but this sorrow goes on forever' is the most quoted close in Tang narrative poetry.
One glance back and smile from Yang Guifei outshines every lady of the palace.

0ae0e3bd-a32e-481f-9719-b283da2da964.why: The spring flood in evening rain and the empty ferry boat drifting crosswise are Wei Yingwu's signature scene.

0bed9b02-991e-4e28-b631-86640147a712.why: The wide wilds where sky sinks below the trees and the moon close in the clear river are a model of quiet travel sorrow.

0f7504df-cda2-4fe2-bc63-867ec2e418e7.why: The Yellow River pouring from the sky and never returning is the poem's thunderous opening.
'Heaven made my talent for a use' is Li Bai's most quoted line of self-confidence.
'When life goes well, enjoy it to the full' is the poem's famous call to drink under the moon.

0fb0189c-8ff3-4106-af94-f6d26d528a1d.why: 'Both of us are fallen wanderers at the edge of the world' is the poem's most quoted line of shared fate.
The heavy and light strings like rain and whispers, pearls dropping on a jade plate, is the classic description of music.
Coming out only after a thousand calls, still half hiding her face behind the pipa, is a proverbial image.

129c074d-f123-45d1-8062-ba949dcc8c6f.why: A child calling the moon a white jade plate is one of the first poems Chinese children learn.

12fdaad8-b197-4526-b56d-c7c713267248.why: 'I will climb the highest peak and see all mountains small' is Du Fu's most quoted line of ambition.
The opening question about Mount Tai and its endless green over Qi and Lu is widely recited.
Nature gathering its wonders on the mountain that splits dawn from dusk is a famous image of Tai's height.

1575c835-1241-4d7b-99dc-6d700549ac65.why: Morning rain, fresh willows and one more cup before Yangguan became the standard Chinese farewell song.

1f83fccf-7476-464b-8cd4-8a2b4569c7a0.why: Drifting clouds for the traveler's heart and the setting sun for an old friend's feeling is the poem's famous couplet.
Green hills across the north wall and white water round the east city set the parting scene.
Waving goodbye as the horses neigh is a well-known farewell close.

1f92134b-bca9-46eb-b2fe-87b30413041a.why: A lone old fisherman in a snowy river among a thousand empty hills is the iconic winter poem.

2188f98e-d5f0-4740-b94b-e1497a3619ee.why: 'Where is home at dusk? Mist on the river brings sorrow' is the poem's famous homesick close.
The yellow crane gone forever and white clouds drifting for a thousand years is widely quoted.
Clear trees at Hanyang and lush spring grass on Parrot Isle make the poem's bright spring view.

22923091-18da-429d-9ef1-6b367fd74b1a.why: The thread in a loving mother's hand sewing her son's coat is the best-known poem about a mother.
Grass cannot repay the sunshine, a proverb for a child's debt to a mother.

22e72306-f41c-4621-a925-83bab7f9d76e.why: A beauty with wet tear stains and no one knows whom she resents is a famous short lament.

22e90c0d-2b59-4500-8e5d-80d38ec4692c.why: The rush home through Ba Gorge, Wu Gorge, Xiangyang and Luoyang captures Du Fu's 'happiest' poem.
Rolling up his books, wild with joy, is the poem's most quoted image of delight.
Singing and drinking with green spring as company on the road home names the season of return.

294bc7b2-b4f8-4a53-be17-a40ded4afd1a.why: Snow on the branches like a thousand trees of pear blossom after a night of spring wind is the most famous snow image in Tang poetry.
The friend vanishing round the mountain, leaving only hoofprints in the snow, is the poem's moving close.
Evening snow at the camp gate and a red flag frozen stiff in the wind are a vivid frontier winter scene.

2c152693-c25f-45ce-8ef2-cbedce1a62bc.why: The bright moon rising over the sea, shared at the same moment across the world, is the classic line of longing under the moon.
Lovers resenting the long night and thinking of each other until dawn.
Putting out the candle to love the moonlight and feeling the dew on a robe is a delicate night image.

2d0385e7-0c72-423f-a538-f66acc9d4c46.why: The Qin moon and Han pass, and the wish for a general to keep the raiders out, is often called the best Tang quatrain.

2e8999a9-9df8-4483-ab1e-0231c3e46320.why: Voices heard in an empty mountain and late sun on moss is Wang Wei's classic image of stillness.

343cf232-56ef-4cfe-88dd-3781c0b57cb5.why: The half autumn moon over Mount Emei reflected in the river is Li Bai's famous youthful travel poem.

34a23446-cb6c-40e2-9d5f-81db0657f3d7.why: Chrysanthemums opening twice and the lone tied boat of a homesick heart are the poem's famous couplet.
Jade dew withering the maple woods opens Du Fu's great autumn cycle.
Waves surging to the sky and clouds dark to the ground at the frontier are a famous image of turmoil.

36d65b5a-7b4d-4b3d-a1b7-6fd144360f8f.why: 'Don't worry that no friend awaits you ahead' is a famous farewell spoken under north wind and snow.

36e09cb4-4fb7-48be-b6c6-c9bd906d9331.why: Playing the qin alone in the bamboo, with only the moon as company, is Wang Wei's classic solitude.

3b5db620-1964-4674-a01d-ad70ba3ebd2a.why: Wang Zhaojun leaving the palace for the desert, leaving only a green tomb at dusk, is the poem's famous couplet.
Countless peaks rushing toward Jingmen open the poem on the beauty's home village.
Her pipa playing barbarian tunes for a thousand years carries her grievance.

3cda5a92-ffa2-4af0-9217-97ce36113705.why: Moonset, crows, frost, maples and the midnight bell of Hanshan Temple make the most famous autumn night poem.

4af86c76-18b3-4069-be90-6d8cef430bc7.why: Three peaks half beyond the blue sky and two rivers split by Egret Isle is the poem's celebrated landscape couplet.
Floating clouds hiding the sun and Chang'an out of sight voices Li Bai's political sorrow.
Phoenixes once played on the terrace, now gone, while the river flows on.

4c7205af-d1e8-48ed-8220-fe095418b95a.why: Asking only whether the winter plum by the window has bloomed is a famously small way to show homesickness.

4f6575cc-12cc-4986-8bfc-5cedac7bb68f.why: The master is somewhere in these mountains, deep in cloud, a famous poem every child learns.

4fa92777-9bd6-45ca-9272-bac30459cf5e.why: Swallows of the great Wang and Xie halls now fly into common homes, the classic image of fallen glory.

526d4ecc-e123-4b9d-a213-958bb947593d.why: The lone city under the mountains and 'spring wind never passes Yumen Pass' make this a top frontier quatrain.

5540f756-f737-4bbd-82da-4a3cc9ca1681.why: 'A winding path leads to a secluded place' became a proverb for hidden beauty.
Mountain light delighting the birds and the pool's reflection emptying the mind is a famous Zen couplet.
All sounds fall silent except the temple bells.

5593d522-b820-4c06-bab6-0ab5a0fc1d46.why: Cutting water with a sword and drinking to drown sorrow are proverbial images of sorrow that cannot be stopped.
Yesterday cannot be kept and today brings many cares, the poem's famous opening.
If life does not go as wished, tomorrow I will loosen my hair and sail away.

56da3304-439a-400b-b283-16de3add74ce.why: Frosted maple leaves redder than February flowers is the best-known autumn line in Chinese.

597f5187-ba3e-4094-ae34-52884eb01c84.why: Every tree in autumn colour and every hill in sunset light is the poem's famous couplet.
Herders driving calves home and hunters returning with game complete the evening scene.

599b8a93-47ab-4426-94c0-ca16eea0ca37.why: Children who ask the returning old man where he comes from is the classic poem of coming home.

59c7eaa9-3c05-4857-8cff-10376706ccb9.why: Du Fu imagines his wife watching the Fuzhou moon alone, a famous reversal of homesickness.
His young children too small to understand why she misses Chang'an.
Her hair damp in fragrant mist and arms cold in clear moonlight is a celebrated tender image.

5bb5c590-5de8-4bfb-aee6-30bc4bcdf99a.why: A full tide widening the banks and a single sail in a fair wind is a widely quoted image of open prospects.
The sea sun rising from the last night and river spring entering the old year shows spring arriving before the year ends.
Wondering how a letter home could reach, the poet trusts the returning geese.

5d05fef6-e4aa-48e5-917d-c29d0e6d6b33.why: Wu and Chu split apart and heaven and earth floating on Dongting is Du Fu's most famous lake couplet.
Long hearing of Dongting and only now climbing Yueyang Tower.
No word from friends, old and ill with only a lone boat.

606d0bd8-31d2-4a7a-97ee-341956e7be60.why: 'How can I bow and scrape to the powerful' is Li Bai's most quoted line of pride.
Mount Tianmu reaching the sky and overtopping the Five Peaks is a famous image of the dream mountain.
Seeing the sea sun from halfway up the cliff and hearing the heavenly cock.

63950163-6a10-4e74-af8a-09886e4ef2a8.why: 'Climb one more storey to see a thousand li further' is among the most recited Chinese lines.

6975adab-25d0-40c6-af3a-3a05847e7717.why: Steam rising over Yunmeng and waves shaking Yueyang city is the most famous description of Dongting Lake.
The lake brimming level in the eighth month sets an autumn scene.
Envying the fishermen is the poem's famous hint asking for office.

6bbd1c2c-8c43-4ffb-b7b3-506d74266cee.why: 'Each festival I miss my family more' on the Double Ninth, with dogwood and climbing heights, is the classic Chongyang poem.

6d2e12c0-c1b8-4242-888c-9dba1a8f93ce.why: The general's arrow found next morning buried in rock is a famous frontier legend in verse.

75db753d-e7da-48a1-a6c0-6ed9147e58db.why: Night rain swelling the autumn pools of Ba and talking by the west window candle is Li Shangyin's best-loved poem.

7c93c162-d424-4d91-b71b-7c9b81713b8c.why: Had the east wind not helped Zhou Yu, the Qiao sisters would have been locked in Bronze Sparrow Tower.

8085e498-9420-4bf8-93ac-c407eca63f03.why: Loving chrysanthemums because no flower blooms after them is the classic autumn flower poem.

83e70b6e-ff59-4a3b-8e81-249ab0cda0c3.why: Raising a cup to the moon so that with his shadow they make three is Li Bai's most famous drinking image.
The moon lingers as he sings and his shadow scatters as he dances.
The moon cannot drink and the shadow only follows, so he must enjoy them while spring lasts.

8435b46d-bbf1-49e5-af66-6f2d5681f1bf.why: Ill and longing for the fields, ashamed to draw a salary while people flee, is a famous line of official conscience.
The world's affairs too vague to foresee and spring sorrow sleeping alone.
Parted among last year's flowers, the flowers bloom again a year later.

861aac3a-3c3d-480c-bdb0-d0c25b7fbf14.why: Clouds across the Qinling and snow blocking Languan Pass is Han Yu's famous image of exile in winter.
One memorial in the morning and banishment eight thousand li by evening.
Wishing to clear away abuses for the sovereign, he will not spare his remaining years.

8baa7c35-9afb-40bf-b5e4-41d9895e2710.why: Red beans from the south sprouting in spring are the classic Chinese token of longing.

8de30193-fba7-4aef-9ff9-c3726a22104d.why: Singing girls who still sing 'Flowers in the Back Court' unaware of a fallen kingdom is the famous warning poem.

8ec59c80-46dc-4916-b069-a25ed8f144ec.why: The straight lone smoke of the great desert and the round setting sun on the long river is a celebrated frontier picture.
Tumbleweed leaving the Han border and geese flying north into the steppe imply the spring migration.
A lone carriage sent to inspect the frontier.

927908c0-999f-4d3f-8192-d67d28f93576.why: Zhuge Liang's stones unmoved by the river and his lasting regret are Du Fu's famous tribute.

9309205e-1d08-4a7b-99ef-4a05a9ee4370.why: Green trees closing round the village and green hills slanting outside the walls is the poem's famous view.
Promising to return on the Double Ninth for the chrysanthemums names the festival directly.
Opening the window to the threshing ground and talking about crops over wine.

9525f99d-39cb-4d04-8650-263493d223e0.why: Leaving Baidi at dawn and the light boat past ten thousand hills is Li Bai's fastest and most joyful voyage.

9972f7bb-ae5b-49e4-87df-381386af66b6.why: New wine, a red clay stove and snow about to fall is the classic winter invitation to a friend.

9d1b6a18-571c-4f25-bfdb-3fe260115c3f.why: 'I love Master Meng, whose grace is known to all' is the famous opening of Li Bai's tribute.
Giving up office in youth and resting among pines and clouds in old age.
Like a high mountain that cannot be climbed, he can only be saluted.

9da0cbe5-52d4-4efc-8be2-2f78f1a8f097.why: The flower path never swept for guests and the rough gate opened for you is a famous welcome couplet.
Spring water north and south of the cottage with gulls coming daily.
Calling the neighbour over the fence to finish the wine.

a353dcb1-12cc-4ca8-af1e-55d1d62445f8.why: 'He died before his campaign succeeded' is the line that has made heroes weep for Zhuge Liang ever since.
Green grass making its own spring by the steps and orioles singing unheard.
Three visits for a plan for the realm and two reigns of loyal service.

a4d718ee-c020-42b4-97df-499cd0076f7b.why: Endless falling leaves and the endless Yangtze rolling on is the most famous autumn couplet in Tang poetry.
A lifelong wanderer, sick and alone, climbing the terrace in autumn on the Double Ninth.
Sharp wind, high sky and wailing apes open the autumn climb.

aa22a168-1c3f-48e1-b7d4-1aa143d66335.why: Saying autumn beats spring, with one crane soaring through the clouds, overturns the usual autumn sadness.

abf4daf0-0c7b-4b0c-87a2-2c48097d6a65.why: Two orioles in green willows and a line of egrets into blue sky is a bright spring picture every child knows.

ae5b1a15-0b5c-4578-8f31-1b60030633a4.why: Meeting an old friend again in the season of falling flowers in Jiangnan quietly carries the sorrow of a lost age.

b1a23dad-694c-41a0-82b7-6a0ddde6d246.why: Orioles, green banks and the 480 temples of the Southern Dynasties in misty rain are the classic Jiangnan spring.

b41e25f5-5a57-497f-a3a2-84bdfb9331f5.why: Chasing off the spring oriole so it will not wake her from a dream of her husband at the frontier.

baccf46a-41c4-4a0f-b90f-37cc35b04a64.why: Ten thousand households pounding clothes under one Chang'an moon in the autumn wind is a famous image of longing.
When will the raiders be beaten so my husband can come home.

bf8918b8-a05a-4ccf-bb2e-3f9b81f6bbfc.why: Mountains ending with the plain and the river flowing into the wild lands is a celebrated landscape couplet.
The home river still follows to see his boat off ten thousand li.
The moon like a flying mirror and clouds forming sea towers.

c1280e87-ac81-4f9b-9de5-377d6af38ae8.why: 'Dew turns white from tonight' marks White Dew, and 'the moon is brighter at home' is the classic homesick line.
Drums stopping all travel and a single goose cry in the frontier autumn.
Brothers scattered and no home left to ask if they live.

c155ff88-deac-4c17-8648-91f478d77ef9.why: A waterfall dropping three thousand feet like the Milky Way falling is Li Bai's best-known landscape image.

c244a5b4-0ed0-48fe-8694-95309acac184.why: No ancients before and none to come after, weeping alone before endless heaven and earth.

c348bc2e-f50d-436b-88b7-c198d63dacfc.why: 'Riding the wind and breaking the waves, I will set my sail across the sea' is the classic line of hope.
Ice blocking the Yellow River and snow on the Taihang stand for the obstacles in life.
The hard road, so many forks, where am I now, the famous refrain.

c39225f9-16b2-4713-a11c-d7030ec3b1c9.why: A girl calling across boats to ask where a stranger lives is a famous lively folk-style scene.

c55ccfa6-8820-40b0-90ff-79412f03c7a8.why: Long spring days, fragrant flowers and grass, swallows and drowsy ducks is a picture of spring.

c6ddd64d-606c-421e-8912-7f37568020b1.why: The spring rain slipping in at night and nourishing all things without a sound is a proverb for quiet kindness.
The good rain knowing its season and falling in spring.
At dawn the city is heavy with wet red flowers.

c8a4faa6-8666-44f9-b4c9-df78d7af844d.why: Asking whether the friend will return when spring grass turns green next year is a famous farewell.

c9362aba-fb50-481b-a4cd-08ddd65cdd2a.why: Death silences grief, but parting from the living hurts forever, the poem's famous opening.
The setting moon filling the beams, still seeming to light his friend's face.
An old friend enters my dream, knowing how I think of him.

ca2c489a-e433-4c0f-8248-77d354f0665e.why: Moonlight on the bed like frost on the ground is the most recited poem of homesickness in China.

cb168b3b-d104-4df7-9868-1e1225ddb941.why: Sleeping through the spring dawn and wondering how many flowers fell is the first poem many children learn.

cc7dff19-adc9-4f03-8862-057d1e7722b3.why: Green hills facing each other and a lone sail coming from the sun is a famous Yangtze view.

ci-01afe1ed44be.why: Fallen into mud and crushed to dust, only the fragrance remains, Lu You's famous line of integrity.
The plum blooming lonely by a broken bridge at dusk in wind and rain.
Not wanting to compete for spring, the plum blooms early and lets other flowers envy it.

ci-04d96fa0cb40.why: Drunk, trimming the lamp to look at his sword and waking to camp horns is Xin Qiji's iconic heroic opening.
Finishing the king's work and winning fame, only to find his hair has turned white, is the famous bitter close.
Roasting meat for the troops and reviewing soldiers on the autumn battlefield.

ci-074bc9ed2d03.why: West wind withering the trees and climbing the tower to gaze to the end of the world is Wang Guowei's first stage of learning.
Wanting to send a letter, but mountains and rivers too long to know where.
Chrysanthemums in sad mist, light cold and swallows leaving set the autumn scene.

ci-08db962e63f8.why: Spring split into dust and water, and the catkins seen as tears of parted lovers, is the famous close.
'Like a flower and yet not a flower' is the famous opening on willow catkins.
Not grieving the catkins gone but the fallen red petals of the west garden.

ci-090d12b2779e.why: A small boat too light to carry so much sorrow is Li Qingzhao's best-known image of grief.
'Things remain but people are gone' became a common idiom of loss.
Wind stops, the flowers are gone, and she is too weary to comb her hair in late spring.

ci-0c8bbf93cf7a.why: The ends of the earth have limits but longing has none, a widely quoted line of love.

A broken dream at the fifth watch bell and parting sorrow in the third month rain under flowers.

ci-0d17f254f2b5.why: Waking from wine on a willow bank to the dawn wind and waning moon is Liu Yong's most famous line.
Lovers have always grieved at parting, worse still in the cold clear autumn.
Holding hands and looking through tears, unable to speak.

ci-1258f9b42748.why: The lone goose refusing every cold branch and the cold sandbar is Su Shi's famous image of proud solitude.
A waning moon in sparse wutong branches as the night grows quiet.
Who sees the recluse coming and going alone, like the shadow of a lone goose.

ci-12800f220378.why: Sunset like molten gold and evening clouds like jade, but where is my love, is the famous opening.
Now worn and grey she would rather stay behind the curtain and listen to others laugh.
The Lantern Festival in mild spring weather, yet who knows if wind and rain will come.

ci-13a35f0c8f52.why: Skin of ice and bones of jade, cool and free of sweat, with breeze and fragrance in the water palace on a summer night.
Counting the days until the west wind, not noticing the years slipping by, waiting out the summer heat.
Asking how late the night is: the third watch, the moon pale, the stars turning low.

ci-17e073b9051d.why: Sorrow as many as misty grass, flying catkins and the rain when plums turn yellow earned He Zhu the name 'He Plum Rain'.
Her light steps do not pass Hengtang road, and he can only watch her dust go.
Who shares her golden years among moonlit bridges and flowered courts that only spring knows.

ci-18053088ea6e.why: Flowers falling no matter what and swallows returning as if known is Yan Shu's most famous couplet.
A new song, a cup of wine, the same weather and pavilion as last year, and the setting sun.

ci-1be1c9ce7025.why: The moon on the willow tops and a meeting after dusk on last year's Lantern Festival is the classic lovers' tryst.
This year's Lantern Festival has the same moon and lamps, but she is gone and tears wet his spring sleeve.

ci-1e1b5658eae5.why: The traveler is beyond even the spring hills at the edge of the plain, a famous image of distance.
Parting sorrow growing endless like spring water.
Plum blossom fading, willows thin and warm grassy wind as the traveler rides off.

ci-20bea5a4447d.why: A windless lake smooth as glass where the boat moves unnoticed until birds start up from the shore.
A light boat on West Lake with green water, fragrant grass and singing everywhere.

ci-24a2329addf7.why: Osmanthus in the three autumn months and ten li of lotus became the famous picture of Hangzhou.
The southeast's finest place, where Qiantang has been rich since ancient times.
Misty willows, painted bridges and a hundred thousand homes.

ci-25580f57a445.why: Ten years of life and death apart, not thinking yet never forgetting, is the most famous mourning lyric in Chinese.
Even if they met she would not know him, his face dusty and hair like frost.
Looking at each other without words, only a thousand lines of tears.

ci-25675e7c4677.why: Autumn on a parting heart makes the character for sorrow, a famous play on 'chou'.
Everyone says the cool evening is fine, but with a bright moon he fears to climb the tower.
The willows will not hold her skirt, but only tie up the traveler's boat.

ci-25f74f14dcc8.why: An old Chang'an road, a slow horse, cicadas, sunset and autumn wind on the plain.
Pleasure fading and drinking friends gone, it is not like being young.
The returning cloud leaves no trace, so where is the old promise.

ci-2605731e1caa.why: Sorrow on the brows and in the heart that cannot be avoided, later echoed by Li Qingzhao.
Too heartbroken to get drunk, tears come before the wine.
Every year on this night the moonlight is like silk, yet the loved one is a thousand li away.

ci-2a3a22779b87.why: Rowing by mistake deep into the lotus and startling a whole beach of gulls is Li Qingzhao's best-loved summer scene.
Remembering dusk at the creek pavilion, too drunk to find the way home.

ci-31673fc0329b.why: A cup of wine ten thousand li from home with the frontier not yet won is Fan Zhongyan's famous line.
Autumn on the frontier looks different, and the geese leave for Hengyang without lingering.
Flutes over frost-covered ground and the general's white hair and soldiers' tears.

ci-32a9a8dea762.why: Old moonlight and flute music by the plum in clear cold is the famous opening of Jiang Kui's plum lyric.
Remembering holding hands where a thousand plum trees pressed on the cold green West Lake.
Sparse plum flowers beyond the bamboo send cold fragrance to the feast.

ci-33b8659ec609.why: Talk of a good harvest in the scent of rice flowers and a chorus of frogs is Xin Qiji's famous summer night.
Bright moon startling magpies and cicadas singing at midnight in the clear wind.
A few stars, a few drops of rain, and the old inn suddenly appears round the bend.

ci-34c945f78dde.why: Fearing the pain of parting, so many things to say but she stops, is a famous line of unspoken grief.
Thinner lately, not from wine and not from autumn sadness.
Only the river by the tower sees her gaze all day, adding a new sorrow.

ci-3c0b86ea7ee1.why: Not wanting the horse to trample the moonlit jade of the stream is Su Shi's famous tender image.
Sleeping by the green willow bridge until a cuckoo calls the spring dawn.
Shallow ripples shining across the fields and faint clouds across the sky.

ci-3fcbfa364a75.why: Moonlight flowing silently down the stream and flutes until dawn under apricot blossoms is Chen Yuyi's famous scene.
Twenty years like a dream, still alive but shaken.
All the affairs of past and present, and fishermen singing at the third watch.

ci-4869dbb2738d.why: Peach and plum in the city fear the rain while spring lives in the shepherd's purse flowers by the creek.
Mulberry buds breaking and silkworm eggs hatching next door in early spring.
Calves lowing on the grassy ridge and crows dotting the cold woods at sunset.

ci-4ba736173ea8.why: Holding up the silver lamp tonight, still afraid this meeting is a dream, is the famous reunion line.
Dancing until the moon sank below the willows and singing until the fan's breeze was spent.
Since parting, how many times in dreams have I been with you.

ci-4f9a7659e224.why: The naughty youngest son lying by the creek peeling lotus pods is Xin Qiji's famous summer village picture.

e73e2743-3752-4ba3-938a-fb59cd3965ee.why: Big banana leaves and plump gardenias after fresh rain is Han Yu's famous summer image.
Red mountains, green streams and pines ten spans around.
A life like this is joy enough, why be bound by others.

ea3f91f0-487e-4df7-826a-3692ef82e64d.why: Everyone knows this grief, but for poor couples every hardship hurts is one of the most quoted lines of mourning.
Jokes once made about death have all come true.
Her clothes given away, her needlework kept but never opened.

eac61312-dec6-4712-a34a-9a71969af9d5.why: Lotus leaves the colour of her skirt and girls hidden among the blooms show the summer lotus harvest.

eb485152-2e04-4d29-a43a-842210b44203.why: The army halting at Mawei against the couple who once laughed at the Cowherd on Qixi is the famous contrast.
Forty years an emperor yet unable to keep a wife like the Lu family's Mochou.
The next life is uncertain and this one is over.

ef5f6c59-7460-402d-a2e6-fb8214ea5332.why: Ten years grinding one sword is a proverb for long preparation.

efaaa86e-5628-40d3-a137-1ae8fcbe41b8.why: The new bride letting her sister-in-law taste the soup first is a beloved picture of quiet wit.

f0cd6afd-c89d-4fc3-b214-bcbf63042e8e.why: Yellow-leaf trees in the rain and a white-haired man under the lamp is one of the most admired couplets.
Ashamed that his cousin visits him so often in his long obscurity.
A silent night with no neighbours at a poor old home.

f1496cf4-4f85-4f9e-9e0e-dd05370641d3.why: A Qiang flute playing the frontier song brings the whole army to tears is the poem's famous close.
No one dares approach the warrior whose beard bristles like a hedgehog.
A fifteen-year-old girl from Liaodong who plays the pipa and sings.

f2f04c30-149d-4b2b-bce1-1334adf84739.why: Falling leaves on foreign trees and a cold lamp for a lonely man is the poem's famous couplet.
White dew dripping in the empty garden beside a lone monk.
Wind and rain settle and lines of geese fly by at evening.

f540f519-e3c4-41c2-b299-f1d255977705.why: Horns mourning alone all night and a fine moon no one watches is Du Fu's quoted couplet.
Cold wutong trees in clear autumn and a guttering candle in the lonely office.
No letters through the dust of war and hard roads in the bleak passes.

f5e021d7-ea56-4341-947c-8fd024018e1c.why: Ninth-month winds howling at Luntai and stones big as dippers rolling is Cen Shen's famous scene.
Armour never removed and wind cutting the face like a knife on the night march.
Snowy horses steaming and freezing and ink-water icing in the tent.

f66fc9fd-c77f-4c19-b4b5-33784cb612cb.why: Withered grass sharpening the hawk's eye and snow gone lightening the hooves is Wang Wei's famous couplet.
Looking back where the eagle was shot, a thousand li of level evening clouds.
Strong wind and the bow string ringing as the general hunts.

f7513920-9e51-4c34-ae10-8ab77d73fb07.why: For whom does the bee toil and make honey from a hundred flowers is a famous question about labour.

f800050a-d7a0-4f12-a614-17fe23df8f41.why: Coming home to see his younger daughter, tears run down his hat strings is the poem's moving close.
Parting this morning, when will he see her again.
Advice to the bride on thrift, filial respect and proper conduct.

f88a6dbd-bf83-458c-b5e2-85fdd1ed98b2.why: Without talent and growing old, he reins in his horse to gaze at the palace gates.
Still shaken to this day, as if part of his soul were never called back.
This road once led him back while rebels swarmed the western suburbs.

f8afed4e-e8cd-467f-afae-51dc149921f7.why: Lotus breeze carrying fragrance and dew dripping from bamboo is Meng Haoran's famous summer couplet.
Wanting to play the zither but having no friend who understands.
Loosening his hair to enjoy the evening cool as the moon rises over the pond.

f8d102c4-b25b-412f-afce-35db35c339d9.why: Peeking at the main hall to see only maids sweeping the emperor's bed is the poem's ironic close.
Cold golden locks and the long day measured by the dragon water clock.
Palace women dress at dawn and gaze for the emperor.

f9798830-48c1-45e3-be90-4028d93954dc.why: Fine clothes draw pointing fingers and high places provoke the gods is Zhang Jiuling's quoted warning.
Flying in the far void, what can the hunter hope to catch.
A lone wild goose from the sea dares not look at the ponds.

fae577a5-da28-4672-83ff-94c97ae2a4a4.why: Merchants napping on calm water and boatmen talking as the tide rises at night is the famous couplet.
Greying temples meet autumn colours and a homesick heart faces the moon.
Clouds part to show Hanyang, still a day's sail away.

fb376b71-91c6-44ee-b2e4-40f5b3f71b8f.why: Sick like Sima Xiangru in the autumn rain at Maoling is the poem's famous close.

fc1bc01d-c281-40fd-9e0d-4c484539e4ae.why: Pear petals covering the ground before a shut door in late spring is the classic image of palace loneliness.

fdc07d9f-95b8-45f7-b1b3-9d272b3416a4.why: The setting sun on old ramparts and a cold chime filling the empty woods is the poem's famous couplet.
The Southern Dynasties are gone and only the Yangtze flows on.
After the leaves fall at the old terrace, autumn enters the homesick heart.

fde30eaa-9b2c-47ce-ba49-c1356353ac9a.why: Bones by the Wuding River still the men in their wives' spring dreams is one of the most piercing anti-war lines.

fe966059-d9e0-41b0-8776-ff745cf877bc.why: Heaven pities the hidden grass and people treasure the evening clearing is Li Shangyin's famous couplet.
Spring gone and early summer still fresh above the walled lane.
Birds fly home lighter once their nests are dry.

fedb06cc-37da-4aaf-8f39-85ebcb08b947.why: One leaf falling in Huainan announces autumn, the classic sign of the Beginning of Autumn.
Last fireflies on jade dew and early geese brushing the Milky Way.
A clear zither in the long night and the west wind stirring green vines.

sup-qingming.why: Drizzle at Qingming and a herd boy pointing to Apricot Blossom Village is the best-known Qingming poem.

sup-yesushansi.why: A tower so high one could pluck the stars and dare not speak for fear of waking heaven is a favourite children's poem.
